title: A bone on Mars in a JPL negative

tellings.quote: this is a bone on Mars

plain: A photographic negative from a NASA lab's Mars mapping work shows what looks like a bone lying on the planet's surface, according to Joe McMoneagle, a former Army remote viewer (someone trained to try to describe distant places with the mind). McMoneagle says he saw it himself in negatives from the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, NASA's lab that builds and flies its planetary probes, and he says plainly: "this is a bone on Mars." If he is right, Mars once had animal life.
